c74object.name: evi.vcf~
c74object.description:
evi.vcf~ is a 'max define' for the evi_vcf.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.vcf~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does.
A twopole linear multimode filter. It is very interesting though. The Pd helpfile says of the cutoff frequency '...may change continuously in time as in an analog voltage controlled filter', but this is not true as it is a direct form filter. However, ymmv. [vcf~] is basically an audio rate version of [bp~] from Pd, which is also ported in evieve as evi.bp~. In evi.vcf~ there is an additional highpass output, as well as the bandpass and lowpass outputs available in Pd.

inlet.description: Center frequency of the resonant peak.
Filter resonance. Can be increasingly high values (e.g. up to 10000).

outlet.description: Resonant bandpass output. Like left outlet of Pd [vcf~].
Resonant lowpass output. Like right outlet of Pd [vcf~].

c74object.discussion: For more information about other reimplementations of Pd filters in evieve, see the 'evieve pd' tab of the helpfile.
